citations.claim: cart drifts toward negative track end, still inside just before failure
first violating step: cart exceeds 2.4m track

counterfactual.change: set initial cart velocity v from -0.3228 to 0.0; without initial drift the controller holds the cart on track

explanation: Controller prioritizes pole upright (theta ~-0.08 rad, margin ~0.72 at failure) with small force ~0.8N well below 50.5N limit, but fails to arrest steady negative cart drift from initial v=-0.32 m/s. Cart moves monotonically negative and exits track at x=-2.41. Removing initial velocity eliminates failure, showing cause is insufficient cart-position correction, not saturation or pole instability.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.418 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts to the far left end of the track while the pole remains nearly upright on top of it. By step 252 the cart is at the left edge out of bounds, yet the pole shows no sign of falling.
